subject.title: Add a Computer Use plugin manifest contract

question: Should OpenClaw accept a metadata-only Computer Use provider manifest contract now, using the linked PR's `contracts.computerUseProviders` and `computerUseProviderMetadata` shape?
rationale: This adds public plugin manifest/API surface for a security-sensitive host-permission discovery path, and the maintainer label plus linked PR indicate a product/API decision rather than a cleanup-close candidate.

options.title: Review the linked PR as the contract candidate
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97939 to settle the manifest fields, docs, tests, and security boundary before closing this issue.

options.title: Pause for host design alignment
options.body: Keep this issue open and hold the PR if macOS host binding semantics are not firm enough for a public manifest contract.

options.title: Reject this manifest surface for now
options.body: Close or narrow the linked PR if maintainers decide Computer Use discovery should wait for a broader host/provider architecture.

recommendation.title: Review the linked PR as the contract candidate
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97939 to settle the manifest fields, docs, tests, and security boundary before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa authored both the maintainer-labeled issue and the linked implementation PR, making them the best available owner for the immediate product/API direction question in this context.
